reviews.text: THIS IS THE BEST. GAME. EVER. No hyperbole, no exaggeration, no lie. I would have said that for Developer Chris McFarland's first Tallowmere, where I have over 1300 hours playing, by far the most of the nearly 2000 Games I own on Steam...but his Tallowmere 2 scratched every itch for a second game I didn't even realize I itched for. Not only masterful, and a perfect improvement on the Original, IMHO, but you get to a point where you can play reflexively; eliminates stress, pain and any downfall while making for a challenging, exhilarating second outing. Pandemic? Tallowmere 2. Bonkers US Election? Tallowmere 2. Worst Year ever? Best Game ever. I'd gained 200 hours playing the Tallowmere 2 Demo, prior to the long-awaited E.A. Release Dec. 4th...and it STILL feels like new. I suppose it could be worse that the biggest shining, glowing Event of the Year is the release of a Game, rather than some personal accomplishment...but then...this Game really is THAT good! Too bad I couldn't Nominate THIS game a week prior to its' release. IT'S. REALLY. THAT. GOOD. (UPDATE- NOV 2021- I DID NOMINATE THIS GAME FOR 2021 GAME OF THE YEAR!! So, I DID get my chance to Nominate what I STILL adamantly maintain is the BEST. GAME. EVER.!!!! My play-time since I wrote this review should speak for itself, too :) I hope y'all have found as much enjoyment with Tallowmere 2 as I have :) )

不论一代还是二代，这个系列的游戏有个最大的特点让人无法忘怀 [h1]你可以在这个肉鸽（rogue）里面用各种意想不到的方式杀死自己！[/h1] 注意，现在二代处于抢先体验！ 最明显的优点是这代的多人游戏界面比前代好找了（开玩笑的w，但这真的是事实），实际上是 [h1]在上海有服务器！[/h1] 毫无疑问的说，你可以在国内与小伙伴联机不卡顿，除非他们在窝评测之后就把上海的服务器卖了。当然本地游戏的界面也比前作好了很多！ [b]如果你是在我写这个评测时第一次看到这个游戏，并且起了兴趣，以下是让你对游戏更深的认识，但是窝建议先考虑第一部，除非你只在意与朋友联机（2020.12.5）[/b] 这个系列是一个惊奇的肉鸽游戏，因为在一个甚至连肉鸽like都不是的游戏，死了就真正意义上一无所有的游戏中，就算你玩到很后面暴毙你都不会过于难过[spoiler]（如果你玩过之后过于难过窝也不负责任_(:з」∠)_）[/spoiler]，因为[b]这游戏是窝见过所有肉鸽里最爽的（以下着重描写一代体验，当然经过两小时二代体验，二代都继承了，依然爽）[/b]。你在打怪过程中已经无穷的解压了，超短的攻击间隔，按多快打多快（大部分武器），没有背包上限！！！一切见到的就拿，不会满，随时换武器，完美体验武器多样性，不用像其他部分肉鸽一样纠结半天拿什么，用不到卖掉，窝就没愁过钱，超快的的数值提升，超快的厉害武器获取，超快的杀怪，打不过就跑，跑得掉就可以回满血，几乎没有任何事情让你头疼，怎么玩怎么解压，所以就算到后面暴毙也不会太难受，当然如果你看了窝说的觉得太简单，不用担心，难度至少在一代安排的很妥当，自己玩了就知道了，二代目前处于抢先体验，近期依然推荐你去玩耍一代，绝对舒服的肉鸽，质量绝对保证，不然窝也不会2代刚出第一天就买。 [b]对于前作玩家[/b] 不知是否是因为窝太菜没到后面(窝最高13层[spoiler]明明很稳但是把自己用火球打死了哭[/spoiler]），还是因为抢先体验，或者其他原因（修改：就是因为抢先体验，去看抢先体验的描述，窝对他充满了期待）首先这代不知为何取消了衣服，只有盾牌和武器和药水，虽然怪物的武器都加入了可以使用的行列，但是前代的好些武器又没了，加入了人物选择和初始武器选择，解锁条件不苛刻，多打几把就解锁了。效果里面有个秒回血的效果也没了加大了难度所以窝很记得，这代目前不能和上一代一样至少前十层甚至前二十层都能突突突，现在随便突过5层都难，也有陷阱和怪物伤害明显提升的原因，难度变高了很多，窝刚刚就看到有个人评测说几下就死就什么都没了给了个差评emmm，目前难度好像有点太高，而且前代10层一个特殊事件，现在层层有，而且窝打了13层还没见到boss，有很多地方可以调整。商人只在家里出现了，取而代之的是给buff的小猫咪，果然还是不太推荐马上就买[b]记住现在处于抢先体验！版本才0.2.0！[/b]，但是那个减百分之40和中国服务器是真的棒，也不是不可以考虑。 对2代的完善表示极大期望，目前难度过高，把前作爽的感觉给舍去了，仅仅是因为怪物和陷阱的伤害上升的极快了，这点前代的难度设置就很合理，但是看到开发者的抢先体验描述，的确是充满了期待，希望能尽快玩到完整版，这是非常非常棒的一款游戏！

一句话描述： 以爽为卖点的超级系横版动作RL游戏。 这游戏前作我就挺喜欢的，和众多动作RL游戏比起来，最大的区别在于，这游戏玩家成长幅度非常巨大。 不同于一般RL忍辱负重攒成型的套路，这游戏随便捡点什么玩意就能爽上半天。 再加上随时能回城补满血，这代还随时能在家里的商人那买卖调整装备， 使得这款游戏只要自己不浪，真的能玩的非常爽。 基本上来说，这游戏的死因大半是自己浪死。 不过这代房间效果有的真的是挺恶心的，遇事不妙回头跑还是挺重要就是了。 这次加了网络联机功能，服务器有国内的，联网速度看起来挺靠谱。 不过游戏一旦开始就不能中途加入，因此现在大多都是私人房，很难碰到路人房。
一些独特的游戏机制让这款游戏非常有毒&上头 （经典我杀我自己 or 快乐刀花式暴毙 从第一代就是老粉了 主要看上了第二代的联机功能 可惜现在bug很多 游戏平衡性和难度曲线也不是很好 喜欢未来能完善！
地形和陷阱跟nm脑瘫一样，经常怪卡在边上你一过去就要被打，不过去又打不到，陷阱也是到处卡你，根本爽不了，反而像是时刻被卡住咽喉一样恶心，就不想让玩家好过反正！

一代老玩家，建议购买并用手柄连发玩，优点是操控自由，游戏很轻松，爽快爆瓜。 打的过就莽，打不过就始终举盾。 唯一缺点也是致命的：装备的获取和运气成分过大，没装备是黑魂 ，有装备暗黑破坏神。敌人打不动你。而且难度没有变化。 没有boss级的敌人 recommended to buy. Its advantages are free control and easy and comfortable game. The only drawback is fatal: the acquisition of equipment depends too much on luck. If not good equipped, it is like Black soul, but good equipped is like Diablo. The enemy can't beat you morethan 1hp. And the difficulty did not change after the 30th floor. and no boss in game。

[h1]Disclaimer[/h1] Everybody knows that the roguelite of 2020 is [b]Spelunky 2[/b]. While I agree with this statement, I must admit that [b]Tallowmere 2[/b] is a close second, even in Early Access. Tallowmere 2 feels like that awesome and underrated underground band, while Spelunky 2 is like a super produced rock stars band - both are great in their own ways. That being said, let’s get to the review [h1]Dr. Feelgood[/h1] Tallowmere 2 is a roguelite that gives a lot of freedom to the players: your character have infinite jumps, a super overpowered shield that doesn’t break, and you can teleport anytime to your home base to be fully healed. In other words, the players have all tools necessary to do good, and when the death comes, it’s all their fault – and this is simply beautiful: no random BS or cheap deaths. It’s also worth mentioning that [b]the combat is beyond satisfying[/b] and almost all weapons have an extra punch that makes your combos feel extremely good. [h1]The cursed kittens[/h1] The goal of the game is to rescue all nine cursed kittens (that show up every five levels) – with each kitten rescued, you gain new abilities and a curse is cast upon your run – like making some enemies spawn in pairs, for instance. Like all roguelites, the levels are procedurally generated (meaning that no two runs are the same) and the death is permanent. [b]There’s no meta-progression[/b], which is very refreshing, given that roguelites (not -likes) and meta-progression are practically a synonym. You won’t grind to get better here; you'll level up as a player. [h1]Bring your friends[/h1] I wonder how great a multiplayer session of Tallowmere 2 must be, and I can’t wait to play it with my friends and relatives on local co-op when the outbreak is over (I don’t play online because my internet is crappy and unstable). [b]The game supports up to fours players[/b], making it the perfect party game for those who love total mayhem. [h1]There’s a lot more to come[/h1] If you’re familiar with the first game, I need to tell you that right now this game feels more like Tallowmere 1.5. [b]There’s a lot more to come during Early Access[/b], like boss fights, suggestions from the community, and other goodies that have yet to be revealed. The pricing is very fair, and I wholeheartedly recommend this game at any price – yes, even when it increases right before the full release. Overall, Tallowmere 2 is a great game to play in short bursts (which I appreciate, as I have a very limited gaming time), and it’s certainly a gem in the making – [b]if you love challenging games and roguelites, don’t pass on it[/b].

This game caters for both people who want to rush around, as well as those of us who want to go through slow and steady. You can slowly snipe down enemies while keeping your shield up and letting enemies kill each other, sit back and throw poison balls or grenades until the enemies below are all dead - or you can rush around with melee weapons. I sometimes enjoy playing by myself, and at other times I'll play with my 4-year old son (who initially wanted most things in the chests but has now learned to share nicely - so daddy can get a decent selection of weapons too these days - as long as I don't want staffs because quite clearly they all belong to him). Not much in the way of permanent progression apart from some starter weapons which is a shame - I like earning permanent bonuses in roguelikes. Hopefully some more good permanent progress options will come up as the game develops.

如果这款游戏没有1代，我一定会给好评。 然而很遗憾，它有1代。 2代在1代基础之上，做了一些简单的修改。如果这些修改可以对游戏体验有很大帮助，那好歹也算是1代的加强版。 然而，非常遗憾的是，2代的这些改进，让整个游戏的趣味性远远低于1代。 1代的每一把武器算是各有千秋，，可是到了2代。。。。武器看起来种类繁多，但实际上2代的武器种类居然远远少于1代。 你告诉我 毒球火球奥数球除了附带伤害之外有什么本质区别？ 斧头火斧头毒斧头奥数斧头除了附带伤害之外有什么本质区别？ 弓箭毒箭火箭奥数箭除了附带伤害之外有什么本质区别？ 事实上本作作为2代，可使用武器仅有斧头、弹球、手雷、弓箭、法杖、镰刀、武士刀、闪电、连枷、抛高球，这10种武器。 而且这10种武器中，还有些武器由于设计缺陷，属于特别垃圾，根本没办法使用的，譬如抛高球这种东西，速度慢落点差就不说了，并且在头顶有墙或者我方在高处的时候无法使用。 还有手雷这玩意，延迟极长，弹跳性能极高，关键它爆炸范围还特别小，一两百个手雷扔出去想碰到敌人还得要靠天气。 然后平衡性。。当然这种游戏本来也不太需要平衡性，可你这设计的也太差了。 近战武器每一个都能把怪击退，可是，怪被击退，并不会打断怪物的攻击，却会因为位移导致近战武器后续攻击打不到，就算憋墙角也不行，打着打着怪就位移飞你头顶上去了。 所以你这击退是负收益啊！ 然后居然装备里还有“击退敌人”词缀，你是多想坑死玩家啊？ 1代有些弱势武器，虽然不强，但是好歹运气好了靠数值能碾压一下。到了2代限制了数值成长，然后呢？远程武器一个多重射击属性直接伤害X3，而且不会击退敌人，可以稳定输出。 近战武器靠啥翻身？个位数的百分比暴击吗？ 哦对了，还有一些词缀也不知道是BUG还是描述问题。 什么“百分比概率吸血”“攻击回复”这两个我是没测出来有啥用处，至少不会回血。 说这么多，如果本作后续还会有大更新，我建议你等它大更之后再看看。 如果以后都没有大更新，而你又非常想玩这个类型。。。。。 那么为什么你不去试试仅要5块钱的1代呢？

作为一款rogue游戏， 每个房间都能传送回血？ 手有多快攻速就有多快？ 近战武器直接瞬移攻击？ 远程武器直接无限击退？ 投掷武器直接满屏炸弹？ 右键盾挡无冷却随便按？ 金币掉得多商店随心买？ ... 关注本游戏，带你探索《卧槽地牢2：猫咪的就算你一身神装有着上面一堆放在别的游戏里强到爆的设定却依然暴毙的诅咒》 ———————————————— 打下来感觉如果想通关的话： 1.奥术弓很重要，无限攻速+眩晕控制+不会自伤，是主要全面的武器，需要多重射击词条或者多重射击祝福的猫，如果有巨大投射物就更好了。 2.另外两件武器，毒球用于攻击下方的敌人，甩链用于攻击隔墙的敌人。重点突出的就是一个稳。扔毒球切记不要自伤。 3.盾牌最好带免疫眩晕的词条，如果有眩晕中毒双免疫的盾就更好了。（升级奖励的第三项随机效果中也可能会随机出“免疫xx”的强化效果） 4.房间效果中的“破坟而起”是最坑人的，死后会在原地扔炸弹，要小心。 5.怪物中最恶心的两种怪，一个是拿镰刀武士刀的瞬移怪，需要用奥术弓打或者远远的扔毒球。另一种是拿电球的怪，电球几乎没有弹道时间，很难躲，一旦他们红眼后就盾挡，等他们攻击后再射他们。 6.怪物红眼时如果被奥术弓控制住后，即使一直射击控制，他们也会有一段很短暂的免控时间发起攻击，所以不要妄想一直控，在他们红眼后适当拿盾挡一下攻击再射。 7.最最最最最重要的就是：怂。
游戏数值有极大问题。重复度极高。

Well, only started on this one a day or two ago, and I'm already nearly at 8 hours with it... that hardly ever happens, and speaks to how darned good this one is. Mostly. There's soooooooooo much to love about the game, but a rather amazing amount of issues that seem all clustered in one very specific aspect... we'll get to that. What this game does well, it does INCREDIBLY well. I've played so many games in this genre. I can think of MAYBE one that does combat as good as this one, which is... er... okay I cant remember which one. But that's unimportant! The thing to know here is that the moment to moment gameplay is masterfully done. And there's some very unique concepts in here too, when it comes to that. One thing that surprised me was the infinite jumps. In most platformers this would be overpowered. In here? It's NECESSARY. And it works. You have more mobility than in any other roguelike platformer, and it has a great feel to it. You'll need that mobility too, because of the sheer bloody chaos of the combat. You'll encounter lots and lots and lots of enemies... hordes of them. Fortunately, you have all sorts of weapons to pick from, and each one is good at different things. This isnt one of those games where you'll have an inventory of like 10 weapons and only ever use the "best" one. No, you're going to have to switch weapons real darned often if you want to get anywhere here. Learning what each one is good at and bad at is very important, and if you dont choose the right one for the right situation, you can expect to take a pile of lightning grenades to the face. Unfortunately for you, your enemies can use every single one of these weapons themselves, and this will serve as their main form of attack. Currently there are only two enemy types that have totally unique methods of attack, but likely there will be more later on. Right now though, there's still plenty of variety in the foes that you'll face, and they are very dynamic, with things like positioning or room traits having a big impact. Unlike a lot of games in this genre, you wont find that many items that could classify as powerups... every 5 levels you'll find a "kitten chamber" where you can rescue a cute kitty who will, for whatever reason, give you a persistent benefit. Things like multishot or speed upgrades or whatever. Of course, you have to not get the cat somehow killed... if a grenadier spawns as the guard to the cat cell, that tends to happen. Irritating, that. Overall though, your character build is all about weapon choices and stats (mostly given by weapons and your shield). Speaking of your shield, it serves a huge purpose in combat. You just plain cant dodge EVERYTHING. Too much from too many angles and plenty of enemies can get in your face. But, your shield provides absolute invincibility against attacks that strike from the direction you're facing. Timing the use of your shield VS the use of your weapons is super important here, and it really works well. While all of that is great, there are some... problems. The biggest one comes from the level generator. It's not that the levels are boring or anything... they arent. It's that they're broken. The game can and very frequently will generate situations where you *cannot* avoid damage. Things like spinning blades in narrow vertical corridors when you need to go upwards while carrying a key (you cant use your shield while holding it, or you drop it), enemies that are in positions where they absolutely can hit you with things from both sides at once, but you cant hit them at all (typically they are above you when this happens), or other screwball problems. Given the frequency with which it does this, it wont take very long before you encounter this. It's definitely a huge problem. In most games I wouldnt tolerate it, but fortunately all the good makes up for the bad, and careful use of your shield can at least *sorta* lessen the damage SOMETIMES. I strongly suggest though that you make sure to grab lots of things that give you an HP upgrade, so you have a large buffer to absorb unfair hits. Another issue is balance... currently you'll find that after awhile you end up with boatloads of gold, yet the shop suddenly stops offering anything that matters. Certain weapons are also a tad overpowered (energy balls in particular) or underpowered / too risky to use (grenades, katanas). This isnt THAT big of a deal, and is to be expected during the EA process, but it IS there. Doesnt exactly ruin the fun though. And honestly that's the extent of the bad. The level gen issues are pretty heavy, but if they can be fixed... oh yeah, this is going to go from "pretty freaking good" to "one of my all-time favorites". Seriously, in an overall sense, it's THAT good, and has soooooo much potential, and there's plenty of cool stuff that I didnt even mention here. I cant wait to see what updates come along for it as early access continues! And I'll be playing it very frequently the whole way. A true hidden gem. Give it a try! There's a reason why so many players get a gazillion hours out of it.

怎么说呢，这个游戏整体来说游玩体验是相当不错的，但是我看了一眼这是2020年发售的游戏，距离我现在写评论已经过了有快2年了，游戏的更新方面的重心都放在了游戏的ui排行榜和封禁以及服务器上，却没有去丰富游戏的内容，导致本身很好的游戏框架被内容的匮乏给限制住了，现在进游戏里面有一大堆功能都是未实现的，而且到现在也一直没实现，希望制作人能明白这个游戏本身的游玩目的，从而转移更新重心吧。我是真的很少见到两年了都没有充实游戏内容本身的游戏更新了。 2022年11月21日晚8点30补充—— 非常感谢开发者对于我的反馈的回复，我这里的担忧不是单纯作为一名玩家的担忧，同样也是对游戏制作人的担忧，我接触过比较多独立游戏开发者，他们大多数都是像您这样的一个人或者几个人的体量在制作游戏，我与他们有着相对较多的交流。作为一个独立游戏制作人，游戏的曝光量和评价无疑是相当重要的一环，游戏在没有内容的填充的情况下就进行抢先测试，就容易在前期消耗掉很多曝光量而不能转化为实际的玩家，同时内容的匮乏也会导致玩家的评价普遍都不是很好，然后进一步降低评价且导致曝光量和玩家转化再次降低，这对于一个独立游戏制作人来说近乎恶性循环。 而我作为一个玩家来说，我认识您和购入游戏很大原因是取决于前作的优秀与特殊，并且也是希望能看见超越前作的游戏产生，因此对于第二部有着比较高的期望，相信也有许多像我一样的玩家是这样的情况，我是真真切切的把这样的游戏作为一个养成来看的，在我的游戏库里也有着许多这样的游戏，我希望能以一个玩家的角度为许多的游戏制作人提供一些不一样的思路，更好的完善自己的作品。因此对于一个希望看到游戏成长的玩家而言，更多想看到的是游戏内容的丰富与充实，所以这仅代表我的个人意见（ps:我自己也做过游戏，虽然没多少人玩也没正式发布，但是我能明白独立游戏开发者同时要兼顾游戏的程序画面等等多方面有多么难，并且优先将游戏的框架系统铺设好有多么重要，因此就我个人而言我会保持绝对的耐心。） 希望游戏能越做越好！

Tallowmere 2 is not a bad game at all, however, it loses so much in comparison to the first game, seems like the dev wanted to improve it but tried a bit too hard and eventually just abandoned it before implementing some features. So here we have new weapons that are not much different and, what's worse, don't matter much. In Tallowmere it made perfect sense to switch to ignite an enemy and then stab/shoot them dead with ice wand, or switch to grenades to decimate all the foes from highground. Well, it's only true to some rather small degree here, weapons lost their uniqueness. Artificial diversity does not really work. Amber axe is not different from the regular one, arcane bow's stun doesn't change the way I use a poison bow, or any boomerang tbh. Even enemies are not so different anymore because now any enemy can yield different weapons so depending on a room modifier you'll meet a bunch of different models that are essentially the same enemy. Instead of having a weapon, an outfit, a shield and a headgear you only have a weapon and a shield now. And merchant pretty much became obsolete. Remember visiting town and finding this awesome otherwordly gear piece in Tallowmere that costs all the gold you managed to get in 25 levels or seeing a great hat and even greater shield when you can only afford one but getting just the shield w/o the hat would drop this particular resist? Yeah, forget it, now you won't see anything "awesome" for sale, only items varying from slightly below average to slightly above average. Some features in the options just don't work, and now it doesn't seem to ever gonna get fixed. Overall it's lost its charm and its thrill, you don't suddenly die because of unfortunate combination of enemies in a corridor with two really unfortunately placed spike traps, you mostly die because you become too careless.

Tallowmere was (and still is) one of the best rouge-likes I've ever played. It deserves vastly more love than it gets. I didn't even know this game existed until today and I bought it instantly as I am more than happy to help this developer out. Crash simulator. This thing crashes every 30 minutes or so. I'm getting so frustrated. To a great degree, this game feels like an attempt at expanding on the original, but still needs a lot of work in stability and balancing with the weapons, kitty powers, time-wasting presentation, and so forth. Literally no reason to have to port back to base to talk to the healer and click through dialogue boxes to get healed, when it's a central aspect of the game strategy. No reason you can't just walk over the town portal and get a heal. This game is very self-indulgent with presentations, dialogue boxes, dragged-out animation, etc. It's good, but unless it gets major work I can't recommend. I feel it has potential and I'll check it out in a few months and revise this review if appropriate. Right now it's a "wishlish and watch" kinda game. I'd hold off. edit: I played a bit more and learned there's a manual Save function. That helped me from losing progress from crashes, but really the game should do it automatically. But as I played past level 20 I started to get more and more crashes to the point of absurdity. Even with all the options at lowest it's still laggy and constantly crashes or even hangs. And it became apparent to me that RNG plays a huge role in success early on, and balance is way out of whack. You need to get good "kitties" which are random power-ups you get as you save kittens. I had a run where there were speed upgrades and +20 health... so literally no help at all. I had another run where I had TWO thunder clouds following me and my body emitted static pulses, and I blasted to Level 25 without even trying. By then I was so bored with the repetition I did that thing where you play carelessly so you get knocked out. Dev has taken this concept as far as it can go. Try the original and skip this one.
